opening: You arrive in Boothbay Harbor on assignment. A missing census taker and unusual reports from the waterfront warrant investigation.

actions.label: Examine the waterfront
actions.discovery: A census badge lies near the waterfront.

inspiration.memory: Your experience as a journalist reminds you to look again before drawing a conclusion.

actions.label: Ask the waitress about local events
actions.discovery: Eleanor says her brother disappeared last month.

inspiration.memory: You recall that listening carefully is part of your work as a reporter.

actions.label: Examine the abandoned luggage
actions.discovery: The abandoned suitcase contains census paperwork.

inspiration.memory: You recall how careful observation has served you in your work as a journalist.

actions.label: Speak with the retired fisherman
actions.discovery: Elias has kept a journal of unusual coastal events.

inspiration.memory: You remember the patience required when interviewing reluctant sources.

actions.failure_observation: Elias declines to share his journal for now.

actions.label: Prepare a written account of your findings
End the investigation and leave town
Buy a meal and rest at the diner
Rest at the boarding house
Take a drink from your flask
Ask Eleanor to explain what happened to her brother
actions.discovery: Eleanor describes disturbing physical changes in her brother before he vanished.

inspiration.memory: You draw on your experience of listening to difficult accounts without interrupting.
You draw on your wartime experience of listening to distressing accounts while remaining attentive.

morale_success.reaction: Eleanor's account leaves you shaken; you need a moment to collect your thoughts.

actions.label: Read Elias's journal carefully
actions.discovery: The journal records unusual changes near the harbor and repeated references to the tide.

inspiration.memory: You draw upon your experience examining records as a journalist.

actions.label: Share your findings with Eleanor and agree on a precaution
actions.discovery: Eleanor agrees to warn people she trusts about the unusual conditions.
actions.failure_observation: Eleanor is not willing to undertake the warning arrangements on the evidence presented.

actions.label: Ask the lighthouse keeper to relay your written account
actions.discovery: The keeper confirms the account has been relayed; no response has arrived.

inspiration.memory: You remember your responsibility as a journalist to communicate what you have learned.

actions.failure_observation: The keeper declines to relay your account; you must find another way to preserve it.

actions.label: Ask Eleanor to keep a copy of your account before departing
actions.discovery: Eleanor accepts a copy of the account for safekeeping.
actions.failure_observation: Eleanor declines responsibility for keeping the account. You still have it and can pursue another route.

actions.label: Move a loose obstruction to examine the waterfront more closely

inspiration.memory: You draw on your experience as a veteran and concentrate on the immediate task.

actions.label: Compare the tide almanac with the waterfront evidence
actions.discovery: The Portland tide almanac identifies true low tide at 2:14 AM; the waterfront cave entrance may be accessible then.

actions.label: Examine the unusual growth at the inlet from dry ground
actions.discovery: Violet kelp grows at the inlet; crabs are moving landward.

actions.label: Inspect Devil's Throat at low tide without entering
actions.discovery: At low tide the entrance to Devil's Throat is exposed.

actions.label: Wait at the waterfront until the low-tide access window
Inspect the lighthouse's protected freshwater well
actions.discovery: The lighthouse freshwater well is protected by copper piping.

actions.label: Re-examine the luggage using the evidence already collected
actions.discovery: A second examination of the abandoned suitcase reveals census paperwork.

actions.label: Return to Eleanor to confirm the warning arrangements
actions.discovery: Eleanor confirms that she has begun warning people she trusts; their safety is not established.

actions.label: Speak with Chief Burroughs about the inquiries
actions.discovery: Burroughs accepts your explanation for now, but advises you to leave town.
actions.failure_observation: Burroughs refuses to accept your explanation and warns against further inquiries.

actions.label: Seek the lighthouse radio despite the opposition
actions.discovery: The keeper confirms that your account has been relayed; no response has arrived.
actions.failure_observation: The approach is obstructed; your account has not been relayed.

actions.label: Ask the lighthouse keeper to relay your account after speaking with the Chief
actions.discovery: The keeper confirms that your account has been relayed; no response has arrived.
actions.failure_observation: The keeper declines to relay the account.

actions.label: Speak with Chief Burroughs at the diner
actions.discovery: Burroughs accepts your explanation for now, but advises you to leave town.
actions.failure_observation: Burroughs refuses to accept your explanation and warns against further inquiries.

actions.label: Trace the unusual growth from dry ground
actions.discovery: The unusual growth follows wet channels inland. Avoiding contact with the water appears prudent.

actions.label: Share the ecological evidence with Eleanor and agree on a precaution
actions.discovery: Eleanor agrees to warn people she trusts about the unusual conditions.
actions.failure_observation: Eleanor is not willing to undertake the warning arrangements on the evidence presented.

actions.label: Seek the keeper and relay your written account
actions.discovery: The keeper confirms that your account has been relayed; no response has arrived.
actions.failure_observation: The approach is obstructed; your account has not been relayed.

actions.label: Compare the inlet growth with the tide almanac from dry ground
actions.discovery: The observed wet channels and the almanac suggest that the tide matters to the unusual coastal growth; this is not Elias's testimony.

events.observation: Evening settles over Boothbay; the harbor grows quiet.
A new day begins. The morning light returns to the harbor.
It is midnight; moving toward the lighthouse now risks encountering patrols.
Elias has withdrawn into isolation; his earlier journal access remains usable.

locations.Harbor Docks: Fishing boats crowd the waterfront. Tide pools lie near the shore.
locations.Harbor Diner: The diner is a gathering place for local conversation.
locations.Sailor's Rest Boarding House: The boarding house provides lodging; the census taker's abandoned luggage is here.
locations.Creek Inlet South: The inlet lies beside the retired fisherman's shack.
locations.Lighthouse (Western Point): The lighthouse has a shortwave radio and a freshwater well.
locations.Devil's Throat Sea Caves: You are at the exterior observation point near Devil's Throat.

pressure.text: The almanac gives a low tide of 2:14 AM on the coming night. Access is time-sensitive.
Unusual kelp and the accounts you have collected give you reason to be cautious around harbor water.
After midnight, patrols are a concern on the approach to the lighthouse.
Your inquiries have attracted official attention. You can explain yourself, seek another route, or leave.

scene.adaptation: AGE provisional scene framing, low-tide access window (02:00–02:30), action durations, and warning follow-up; source specifies 02:14 low tide, ecology, cave and lighthouse features, not these exact procedures. No infection, cave interior, patrol encounter or confirmed protection adjudicated. v17: provisional social pressure clock, official interference and alternate relay routes; no physical patrol combat or infection adjudicated. v18: provisional point-map topology, route durations and encounter locations; movement is charged separately from local action duration. The cave node denotes an exterior observation point; retreat is unrestricted and interior entry remains unsupported. v19: 20 advisory Critical Decisions, authored decision identities and optional GM classification; mechanical actions no longer end the game at 20. Default observation 10 minutes. Existing fictional deadline retained. v20: advisory target revised to 24 Critical Decisions; no change to fictional deadline or mechanical resolution. v21: advisory Spotlight lifecycle and eligible Scene frames, not scripted event sequences; Scene and Spotlight controls do not advance time. v22: elapsed-time activity and sleep at the boarding house; initial awake duration zero is provisional. No location is assumed safe; ordinary meals are not necessarily restorative. Sleep and rest may stop at explicitly authored interruptions. v23: canonical Weariness-adjusted Sleep Limit; prospective overdue-hour accounting. See vault-sarnalen PR #214. v24: generalized named clocks; Eleanor's warning distribution takes one hour after agreement (provisional); ecological Encounter Tension uses source-described crabs and filaments and offers an alternate evidence route. No actual infection or patrol combat. Sleep Limit revised: subtract Degrees of Weariness and Stress in Index space, superseding raw Weariness (vault-sarnalen PR #215). v26: reconcile alternate GM approaches with combined Degree Sleep Limit. Native individual Interaction Tests: ordinary PRE TN7, pivotal opposed PRE vs INT, conditional PC secondary INT; Demeanor uses signed Test margin bounded by existing ordinary limits. v27: generated local activities and persistent bounded records, with no invented evidence or facts. v28: optional decisive danger Beats at existing inlet and lighthouse nodes; authored stakes and approaches are provisional, no infection or injury adjudication. Midnight relay requires patrol passage; retreat remains available. v29: Elias withdraws into isolation at dawn (provisional timing based on authored illness and isolation); previously granted journal access persists. Independent ecological/almanac inference is not witness testimony. GM-only function projection derives availability from current flags and actions. v30: optional player-authorized initial Emotional Commitment at level 1 in an established local NPC interaction, once per scenario session. No automatic outburst, background Hook or escalation across sessions. v31: curated five-stage Fear! DXD profiles for PC and five major NPCs; unknown biography remains null. Native Skill names replace legacy aliases; additional Skills and contextual Disabilities are provisional. No imported PML or setting-specific profession grants. v32: local danger uses native Narrative TN penalty conversion; Burroughs applies Investigate when evaluating the reporter's account; contextual Emotional penalties limited to one Test per trait per session, with acquired Commitment disability recorded as a native Trait. Explicit wartime analogy approach only when player chooses it. No automatic emotional inference. v33: optional contextual nominations select owned capabilities from bounded action scopes; native gathering determines effective levels. No arbitrary DM or trigger overrides. v34: PML-independent professional qualification and career histories; provisional ages and ranks; no lifetime XP simulation. v35: seeded mission-start Addict Discipline check, Addicted status, explicit contextual penalties and native Emotional restorative Stress recovery adjustment. No inferred mood or automatic drinking. v36: witnessed Emotional Commitment leverage in subsequent pivotal Burroughs interactions; temporary negative Demeanor overlay, floor EC/2, superseded by persistent relationship change. v37: automatic Character Hooks and Character Emphasis XP, distinct from native compulsory Disability effects; one award per concern per Scene; automatic Inspiration remains unchanged. v38: sustained official scrutiny promotes the ordinary profession Hook to a persistent adverse adjustment when the committed attention clock is complete. No stacking or new mutable circumstance track.

town_inquiry.background: Waterfront inquiry and encounters in town.

inlet_inquiry.background: Investigation of the inlet and the fisherman's account.

official_attention.background: The inquiries have drawn official attention.

evidence_relay.background: An opportunity to preserve or relay evidence.

spatial.provenance: Provisional AGE topology and travel costs, not surveyed historical geography. The tidal gate governs access to an exterior cave observation point, not entry into the cave; retreat from that exterior point remains possible.

official_attention.name: Official attention
official_attention.observation: Word of your inquiries has spread. You have been asked to speak with Chief Burroughs.

encounter_table.observation: Crabs move away from the water in an unusual landward procession.
Violet filaments cling to the wet margin; you can investigate without entering the water.

beat:inlet_withdrawal.objective: Withdraw from the wet margin without coming into contact with the growth
beat:inlet_withdrawal.stakes: A hurried retreat across the rough margin risks a fall and distress; the dry-ground route remains available.
beat:inlet_withdrawal.terrain: Rough wet margin adjacent to dry ground

plan_route.description: Study the dry approach and withdraw along it

beat:inlet_withdrawal.success_observation: You withdraw to the dry margin without touching the growth.
beat:inlet_withdrawal.failure_observation: You stumble on the rough margin, but reach dry ground shaken and winded. No water contact is established.
beat:inlet_withdrawal.degree_observation: You identify firm footing for the remainder of the withdrawal.

beat:patrol_approach.objective: Avoid the patrol and approach the lighthouse
beat:patrol_approach.stakes: Failure means the approach is watched and relay is delayed; withdrawing remains possible.
beat:patrol_approach.terrain: Exposed coastal approach with rough ground

quiet_approach.description: Time the approach to avoid attention

observe_patrol.description: Study the patrol's movement before attempting passage

beat:patrol_approach.success_observation: You reach the lighthouse approach without attracting the patrol's attention.
beat:patrol_approach.failure_observation: The patrol notices movement; you break off the approach before reaching the radio.
beat:patrol_approach.degree_observation: You have a clear opportunity to seek the radio now.

tide_evidence.purpose: Establish evidence connecting coastal anomalies and the tide

water_warning.purpose: Establish reason to avoid contaminated water

preserve_account.purpose: Preserve the investigation outside the protagonist's sole possession

professional_scrutiny.fact: The reporter's investigation attracts official scrutiny.

tenacious_record.fact: The reporter is tenacious about documenting what happened.

sustained_official_scrutiny.fact: Repeated inquiries have completed the official-attention clock.
